history.summary: A well-sized 936 sqft 2BR at Blue Horizon, a large D05 (West Coast) leasehold completed 2005, at $1.39M / $1,484 psf. Wide 2BR buyer pool, deep 96-txn history and a solid 4.9%/yr resale CAGR make this a sound mid-quantum investment.
history.rating_rationale: This hits the investment sweet spots: a 2BR (widest tenant and resale pool), a $1.39M quantum that is highly liquid, 96 URA txns supporting a reliable 4.9%/yr resale CAGR (above the regional baseline), and a 936 sqft size that's genuinely usable (not shoebox, not oversized). Listing PSF ($1,484) is only ~1.7% above the project median — fairly priced. Blue Horizon is a large West Coast development with One-North / NUS / Kent Ridge employment demand nearby. Main caveat: no MRT within easy walk per dossier and the development is 99yr from 2005 (lease decay), but the fundamentals clearly support a Buy.
red_flags: No MRT within easy walk per dossier (West Coast pocket)
West Coast location is somewhat car-dependent
catalysts: 4.9%/yr resale CAGR on 96 txns — reliable and above baseline
D05 One-North / NUS / West Coast employment catchment; fairly priced vs median
